text: Thanks. That means the fix so far wasn't the cause. I can't see Novig's answer from here, so the next build (v0.114.31) makes the error message say what Novig last returned for the order (its status and how much is left, or the error code if reading it failed). Send me a screenshot of that message from it and I can fix the real cause. Also included: any order status other than PENDING/OPEN now counts as finished, and v0.114.30 fixes the Live switch.
